sec: ADPKD: features, genes, Ravinson's criteria · p786

items.q: Regarding ADPKD, which statement is correct?
opts: Autosomal dominant with variable expression, so few develop ESRD
Autosomal recessive, with ESRD in all patients by 40 years
Autosomal dominant with no spontaneous mutations
Autosomal recessive with only 5% of nephrons involved
items.exp: ADPKD: autosomal dominant with variable expression (few develop ESRD), 10% due to spontaneous mutation, multiple bilateral renal cysts as hallmark, and only 5% of nephrons involved. (Book p786)

items.q: What percentage of ADPKD is due to spontaneous (new) mutation?
items.exp: ADPKD: 10% is due to spontaneous mutation (no family history). (Book p786)

items.q: Fill up: In ADPKD, only ______% of nephrons are involved, so renal function is preserved for long.
items.exp: ADPKD involves only 5% of nephrons — hence preserved renal function despite massive cystic kidneys. (Book p786)

items.q: Multiple bilateral renal cysts are the hallmark of ADPKD.
opts: False — the hallmark is a single cyst per kidney
False — the hallmark is medullary nephrocalcinosis
items.exp: Hallmark of ADPKD: multiple bilateral renal cysts; genes PKD1 (85%) and PKD2 (15%). (Book p786)

items.q: Match the ADPKD gene with its chromosome and product — 1) PKD1  2) PKD2 … A) Chr4q — polycystin 2, milder disease  B) Chr16p — polycystin 1, 85% of cases
items.exp: Gene defect in ADPKD: PKD1 on Chr16p (85%) → polycystin 1; PKD2 on Chr4q (15%) → polycystin 2 (milder disease); PKD3 (GANA B). (Book p786)

items.q: PKD1 on chromosome 16p accounts for what percentage of ADPKD?
items.exp: PKD1 (Chr16p → polycystin 1) accounts for 85%; PKD2 (Chr4q → polycystin 2) accounts for 15% and causes milder disease. (Book p786)

items.q: A patient with ADPKD has a PKD2 mutation. Compared with PKD1 disease, the expected course is:
opts: More severe disease with earlier ESRD
items.exp: PKD2 (Chr4q → polycystin 2) produces milder disease than PKD1, which accounts for 85% of cases. (Book p786)

items.q: Why is hypertension so common in ADPKD, even early in the disease?
opts: Polycystin is also present in vascular smooth muscle
Renin secretion is switched off by the cysts
Sodium is lost in the urine because of tubular damage
Cardiac output is reduced by pericardial involvement
items.exp: The boxed note: polycystin is also present in vascular smooth muscle, and hence in ADPKD hypertension is present. (Book p786)

items.q: The polycystin protein of ADPKD is expressed in vascular smooth muscle, which helps explain the hypertension of ADPKD.
opts: False — polycystin is restricted to tubular epithelium
False — the hypertension of ADPKD is due to anaemia
True, but only in PKD2 disease
items.exp: Boxed note: polycystin is also present in vascular smooth muscle → in ADPKD, HTN is present. (Book p786)

items.q: Match the Ravinson's criteria age band with the number of cysts needed for diagnosis of ADPKD — 1) 15–39 years  2) 40–59 years  3) ≥60 years … A) ≥2 cysts bilaterally  B) ≥3 cysts (unilateral or bilateral)  C) ≥4 cysts bilaterally
items.exp: Ravinson's criteria (based on USG, the investigation of choice): 15–39 years — ≥3 cysts (u/l or b/l); 40–59 years — ≥2 cysts bilaterally; ≥60 years — ≥4 cysts bilaterally. (Book p786)

items.q: Fill up: The diagnostic criteria for ADPKD (Ravinson's criteria) are based on ______, which is the investigation of choice.
items.exp: Ravinson's criteria for ADPKD diagnosis are based on USG, marked as the investigation of choice (IOC). (Book p786)

items.q: A 45-year-old with a family history of ADPKD needs how many cysts on ultrasound to satisfy Ravinson's criteria?
opts: Only one cyst in either kidney
items.exp: For ages 40–59 years the criterion is ≥2 cysts bilaterally (≥3 cysts u/l or b/l applies at 15–39 years, and ≥4 bilaterally at ≥60 years). (Book p786)

items.q: A 66-year-old woman with a family history of ADPKD has a renal ultrasound. How many cysts bilaterally are required by Ravinson's criteria?
items.exp: For age ≥60 years, Ravinson's criteria require ≥4 cysts bilaterally. (Book p786)

items.q: All but one of the following are correct Ravinson's criteria pairings. Which is the odd one out?
items.exp: In the 15–39 year band the requirement is ≥3 cysts (unilateral or bilateral), not ≥2 bilaterally (which is the 40–59 year rule). (Book p786)

items.q: The gross specimen figure labelled 'cysts in ADPKD' shows kidneys in which the external and cut surfaces demonstrate:
opts: Multiple cysts of varying size replacing normal parenchyma
Uniformly small kidneys with cortical scarring
Dilated spongy medullary collecting ducts without macrocysts
items.exp: The figure of ADPKD (external and cut surface) shows multiple cysts of varying size in both kidneys, the hallmark of the disease. (Book p786)
